explanation: f'(x)=e^{-x}(2x-x^2-1)=-(x-1)^2e^{-x}. It is negative on both sides of x=1, so the stationary point is neither a local maximum nor a local minimum. The function has no local extrema.

answers.correct_value: The function $f(x)$ has no local extrema
answers.wrong_value: There is a local maximum at $x=1$
